newsitem.title: USA: Treasury's Rubin -- US growth firm, inflation low.
newsitem.headline: Treasury's Rubin -- US growth firm, inflation low.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Tuesday said the statement from the Group of Seven (G7) nations summit "spoke very well for itself" and added that U.S. economic growth remains firm and inflation low.

When asked about the Employment Cost Index (ECI) and durable goods data released on Tuesday, Rubin replied: "The real question is what is happening in the underlying economy. In my view, growth is solid and inflation is likely to be low."

Both reports undershot economists' forecasts, with the ECI reading up 0.6 percent compared with the consensus forecast of a 0.9 percent rise, and durables orders off 3.0 percent against a forecast of no change from the previous month.
Rubin made his comments to reporters before a speaking engagement in New York.
